lines.trans: Not one broken cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbours.
You are smiling, Mateo! I saw it clearly under the lamp!
Must be a trick of the frosted glass, Clara.
Clara, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...
Is everything all right in Room Four, Carmen? Did the buzzer ring twice again?
I have grown very fond of that double ring: is Room Four free next week?

words.gloss: next (hasta la próxima = until next time)

lines.trans: Wait: you want to extend your stay with us, Carmen?!
Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, madam.

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: Written in pencil right here! Rocio and Ernesto will be thrilled!
Oh, by the way, the postman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate mailbox.
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
Not one broken cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbours.

Must be a trick of the frosted glass, Clara.
Clara, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...
Is everything all right in Room Four, Carmen? Did the buzzer ring twice again?
I have grown very fond of that double ring: is Room Four free next week?

words.gloss: next (hasta la próxima = until next time)

lines.trans: To grow fond of.

Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, madam.

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: Written in pencil right here! Rocio and Ernesto will be thrilled!
Oh, by the way, the postman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate mailbox.
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
Not one broken cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbours.
You are smiling, Mateo! I saw it clearly under the lamp!

Clara, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...

words.gloss: next (hasta la próxima = until next time)

lines.trans: Wait: you want to extend your stay with us, Carmen?!
Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, madam.

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: Written in pencil right here! Rocio and Ernesto will be thrilled!
Oh, by the way, the postman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate mailbox.
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
Good night!

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: Aceptamos el presupuesto para arreglar la sala.
examples.trans: We accept the budget to fix the room.

examples.text: ¿Aceptan pago en efectivo en este puesto?
examples.trans: Do they accept cash payment at this stall?

meanings.note: Expresses sudden realization or understanding.

examples.text: ¡Ah, ya entiendo el mapa!
examples.trans: Ah, now I understand the map!

examples.text: ¿Ah, sí? Qué buena noticia.
examples.trans: Oh really? What good news.

ampliar.gloss: to extend; to expand; to enlarge

meanings.en: to extend; to expand; to enlarge
meanings.note: Stress falls on the -í- with an accent mark in singular and 3rd plural present forms (amplío, amplía); ampliar la estancia = extend one's stay.

examples.text: Queremos ampliar nuestra estancia en la posada dos días más.
examples.trans: We want to extend our stay at the inn by two more days.

examples.text: Van a ampliar la terraza del café este verano.
examples.trans: They are going to expand the café terrace this summer.

meanings.note: Antes de means 'before' a noun or infinitive.

examples.text: Llegué diez minutos antes.
examples.trans: I arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: Antes de salir, cierra la ventana.
examples.trans: Before leaving, close the window.

meanings.note: Right where the speaker is.

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave.
examples.trans: Here is your key.

examples.text: Nos sentamos aquí bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We sit right here under the tree.

meanings.note: Bajo llave means 'under lock and key'; as an adjective (bajo/baja), means 'low' or 'ground' (planta baja).

examples.text: Nos sentamos bajo el limonero.
examples.trans: We sit under the lemon tree.

examples.text: Guarda la caja bajo llave.
examples.trans: Keep the box under lock and key.

meanings.note: Before an adjective (bien caliente), means 'nice and hot'.

examples.text: Todo va muy bien hoy.
examples.trans: Everything is going very well today.

examples.text: El té sale bien caliente.
examples.trans: The tea comes out nice and hot.

meanings.note: Shortens to buen before masculine singular nouns (buen viaje); ¡Buenos días! = Good morning!

examples.text: ¡Buenos días a todos!
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone!

examples.text: Hace muy buen tiempo hoy.
examples.trans: The weather is very nice today.

examples.text: Salta el buzón de voz.
examples.trans: It goes to voicemail.

examples.text: Dejé un mensaje en el buzón.
examples.trans: I left a message on voicemail.

meanings.note: Invariable before masculine or feminine singular nouns (cada día, cada mañana).

examples.text: Abro la cafetería cada mañana.
examples.trans: I open the cafe every morning.

examples.text: Cada habitación tiene su llave.
examples.trans: Each room has its own key.

meanings.note: Coger cariño a = to grow fond of; also a warm term of endearment in Spain.

examples.text: El cariño es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The affection is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el cariño.
examples.trans: We talk about the affection.

meanings.note: Built from carta (letter); feminine: la cartera.

examples.text: El cartero está aquí.
examples.trans: The postman is here.

examples.text: Vemos los carteros desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the postmen from the door.

meanings.note: Used for numbers, temperatures, and emphatic 'zero!'.

examples.text: Hoy tenemos cero problemas.
examples.trans: Today we have zero problems.

examples.text: El marcador está a cero.
examples.trans: The score is at zero.

cerrar.gloss: to close; to lock; to turn off (a valve)

meanings.en: to close; to lock; to turn off (a valve)
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> ie: cierro).

examples.text: Cierro la tienda a las ocho.
examples.trans: I close the shop at eight.

examples.text: Anoche cerramos todas las contraventanas.
examples.trans: Last night we closed all the shutters.

cierto.gloss: certain; true (por cierto = by the way)

meanings.en: certain; true (por cierto = by the way)
meanings.note: After ser ('es cierto') it means 'true'; before a noun it means 'a certain'; por cierto is the everyday phrase 'by the way'.

examples.text: Es cierto que el pan recién hecho huele de maravilla.
examples.trans: It is true that freshly baked bread smells wonderful.

examples.text: Por cierto, ha llegado una postal para vosotros esta tarde.
examples.trans: By the way, a postcard arrived for you this afternoon.

examples.text: Mi destino está claramente trazado.
examples.trans: My destiny is clearly mapped out.

examples.text: Yo claramente
examples.trans: I claramente

meanings.note: Combines with mí/ti to form conmigo ('with me') and contigo ('with you').

examples.text: Tomo café con leche caliente.
examples.trans: I take coffee with hot milk.

examples.text: Habla con calma, por favor.
examples.trans: Speak calmly, please.

examples.text: El correo es de ayer.
examples.trans: The email is from yesterday.

examples.text: Tengo cien correos nuevos.
examples.trans: I have a hundred new emails.

meanings.note: Refers to window glass or crystal.

examples.text: El cristal está aquí.
examples.trans: The windowpane is here.

examples.text: Vemos los cristales desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the windowpanes from the door.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Tenemos cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: We have four tables inside.

examples.text: La habitación cuatro da al patio.
examples.trans: Room four looks out onto the courtyard.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

meanings.note: El doble de... means 'double the amount of...'.

examples.text: El doble está aquí.
examples.trans: The double is here.

examples.text: Vemos los dobles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the doubles from the door.

meanings.note: Los dos / las dos means 'both'.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas azules en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two blue cups on the table.

examples.text: Compra las dos válvulas por favor.
examples.trans: Buy both valves, please.

meanings.note: Un efecto de la luz means 'a trick of the light'.

examples.text: La luz dorada crea un efecto precioso sobre el cristal.
examples.trans: The golden light creates a lovely effect on the glass.

examples.text: El descanso hizo efecto enseguida en su tobillo.
examples.trans: The rest took effect right away on her ankle.

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Works like gustar: me encanta el té = I love tea (tea delights me).

examples.text: Me encanta el olor a pan caliente.
examples.trans: I love the smell of warm bread.

examples.text: De niño le encantaban los trenes.
examples.trans: As a boy he loved trains.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb with irregular past participle escrito.

examples.text: Escribo la nota con lápiz azul.
examples.trans: I write the note in blue pencil.

examples.text: Mi hermano me escribió una postal corta.
examples.trans: My brother wrote me a short postcard.

meanings.note: Forms: ese, esa, esos, esas.

examples.text: Pásame ese cuaderno azul.
examples.trans: Pass me that blue notebook.

examples.text: Esa maleta pertenece a un cliente.
examples.trans: That suitcase belongs to a guest.

meanings.note: Cristal esmerilado is translucent frosted glass that softens bright light.

examples.text: La lámpara tiene una pantalla de cristal esmerilado.
examples.trans: The lamp has a frosted glass shade.

examples.text: El cristal esmerilado deja pasar una luz muy suave.
examples.trans: Frosted glass lets very soft light through.

esperar.gloss: to wait; to wait for; to hope

meanings.en: to wait; to wait for; to hope
meanings.note: Covers both 'wait (for)' and 'hope'.

examples.text: Espere un momento, por favor.
examples.trans: Wait a moment, please.

examples.text: Esperamos que descanse muy bien.
examples.trans: We hope you rest very well.

estancia.gloss: stay (at a hotel or inn); room

meanings.en: stay (at a hotel or inn); room
meanings.note: Polite hospitality word for a guest's stay (feliz estancia, ampliar la estancia).

examples.text: Le deseamos una estancia muy agradable en nuestra posada.
examples.trans: We wish you a very pleasant stay at our inn.

examples.text: Carmen decidió ampliar su estancia dos semanas más.
examples.trans: Carmen decided to extend her stay by two more weeks.

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: Forms: este (m sg), esta (f sg), estos (m pl), estas (f pl).

examples.text: Este patio es muy tranquilo.
examples.trans: This courtyard is very quiet.

examples.text: Esta mañana hace mucho sol.
examples.trans: This morning it is very sunny.

meanings.note: With the definite article ('el extranjero'), refers collectively to foreign countries ('abroad'). In Paquita Salas, Paquita humorously says 'el mundo del extranjero' ('the foreign world').
As an adjective ('extranjero/a'), modifies nouns to mean from another country.

examples.text: En PS tenemos muchos contactos con el mundo del extranjero.
examples.trans: At PS we have many contacts with the foreign world.

examples.text: Se fue a estudiar inglés al extranjero durante todo el verano.
examples.trans: She went to study English abroad for the whole summer.

meanings.note: Invariable for gender ('un hombre feliz', 'una mujer feliz'). Forms its plural by changing -z to -ces ('felices').

examples.text: Es que trabajar en el teatro me hace muy feliz.
examples.trans: It is just that working in the theater makes me very happy.

examples.text: Estamos todos muy felices por el éxito de tu nueva serie.
examples.trans: We are all very happy about the success of your new series.

fundir.gloss: to melt; to blow (a fuse or bulb)

meanings.en: to melt; to blow (a fuse or bulb)
meanings.note: Se ha fundido la bombilla = the bulb has blown.

examples.text: Se ha fundido la bombilla de la cocina.
examples.trans: The kitchen bulb has blown.

examples.text: El sol funde la nieve.
examples.trans: The sun melts the snow.

meanings.note: The small safety part in an electrical panel.

examples.text: El fusible está en la caja de la entrada.
examples.trans: The fuse is in the box by the entrance.

examples.text: Necesito un fusible nuevo.
examples.trans: I need a new fuse.

grande.gloss: big; large; great (gran before sg noun)

meanings.en: big; large; great (gran before sg noun)
meanings.note: Shortens to gran before any singular noun (un gran libro, una gran idea).

examples.text: Tenemos una mesa grande en el patio.
examples.trans: We have a big table in the courtyard.

examples.text: Es una gran noticia para todos.
examples.trans: It is great news for everyone.

meanings.note: Describes thick envelopes, walls, or coats.

examples.text: Es una pieza gruesa.
examples.trans: It is a thick piece.

examples.text: este sobre grueso
examples.trans: this thick envelope

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

meanings.note: Plural habitaciones.

examples.text: La habitación está aquí.
examples.trans: The room is here.

examples.text: Vemos las habitaciones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rooms from the door.

meanings.note: ¿Qué hora es? asks the clock time.

examples.text: La hora está aquí.
examples.trans: The hour is here.

examples.text: Vemos las horas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the hours from the door.

meanings.note: Ir a + infinitive expresses near future ('going to do').

examples.text: Voy a abrir la puerta ahora.
examples.trans: I am going to open the door now.

examples.text: ¿Cómo va todo esta mañana?
examples.trans: How is everything going this morning?

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Third-person singular indirect object pronoun.

examples.text: Le llevo una taza de té caliente.
examples.trans: I am bringing you/her a cup of hot tea.

examples.text: ¿Le gusta la habitación del patio?
examples.trans: Do you like the courtyard room?

meanings.note: Plural indirect object pronoun.

examples.text: Les preparo el desayuno enseguida.
examples.trans: I will prepare breakfast for you all right away.

examples.text: Les debo toda la verdad.
examples.trans: I owe you both the whole truth.

meanings.note: Está libre = it is vacant / available.

examples.text: Es una pieza libre.
examples.trans: It is a free piece.

examples.text: está libre
examples.trans: is free

meanings.note: Libro de reservas = reservation ledger.

examples.text: El libro está aquí.
examples.trans: The book is here.

examples.text: Vemos los libros desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the books from the door.

llevar.gloss: to carry; to wear; to take; to spend (time)

meanings.en: to carry; to wear; to take; to spend (time)
meanings.note: Versatile verb for carrying items, wearing clothes/glasses, or duration.

examples.text: Llevo dos tazas calientes al jardín.
examples.trans: I carry two hot cups to the garden.

examples.text: Hoy lleva un abrigo gris oscuro.
examples.trans: Today he is wearing a dark grey coat.

lo.gloss: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)

meanings.en: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)
meanings.note: Direct object pronoun before verbs (lo veo), and neuter article in lo que ('what') or lo mejor ('the best').

examples.text: Ya lo veo encima del estante.
examples.trans: I see it now on the shelf.

examples.text: Lo mejor del patio es la calma.
examples.trans: The best part of the courtyard is the calm.

meanings.note: Table, ceiling, or reading lamp.

examples.text: La lámpara está aquí.
examples.trans: The lamp is here.

examples.text: Vemos las lámparas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lamps from the door.

meanings.note: Plural los lápices; a lápiz = in pencil.

examples.text: El lápiz está aquí.
examples.trans: The pencil is here.

examples.text: Vemos los lápices desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the pencils from the door.

meanings.note: First-person singular object/reflexive pronoun.

examples.text: ¿Me pasas la sal, por favor?
examples.trans: Can you pass me the salt, please?

examples.text: Vivo aquí y trabajo aquí.
examples.trans: I live here and I work here.

meter.gloss: to put in; to tuck in

meanings.en: to put in; to tuck in
meanings.note: Everyday Spanish verb specifically for putting something inside a pocket, bag, or drawer.

examples.text: Meto las llaves en el bolsillo.
examples.trans: I put the keys in my pocket.

examples.text: Metimos las sillas dentro por la lluvia.
examples.trans: We brought the chairs inside because of the rain.

meanings.note: Agrees with the noun it describes.
In ahora mismo, meaning right now, mismo strengthens the time word ahora. Now comes from ahora; mismo supplies emphasis without agreeing with a person in this expression.

examples.text: Tenemos el mismo trabajo.
examples.trans: We have the same job.

examples.text: Ahora mismo estoy ocupada.
examples.trans: I am busy right now.

meanings.note: Agrees before nouns (mucha agua, muchos años); invariable after verbs (llueve mucho).

examples.text: Hoy tenemos mucho trabajo.
examples.trans: Today we have a lot of work.

examples.text: Muchas gracias por el café.
examples.trans: Thank you very much for the coffee.

meanings.note: Accented más means 'more / most'; de más = extra.

examples.text: ¿Quiere un poco más de té?
examples.trans: Would you like a little more tea?

examples.text: Es la habitación más tranquila.
examples.trans: It is the quietest room.

meanings.note: Ni... ni... = neither... nor...; ni una gota = not a single drop.

examples.text: No cae ni una sola gota.
examples.trans: Not a single drop is falling.

examples.text: No tengo ni papel ni bolígrafo.
examples.trans: I have neither paper nor pen.

meanings.note: ¡Buenas noches! = Good evening / Good night; esta noche = tonight.

examples.text: La noche está aquí.
examples.trans: The night is here.

examples.text: Vemos las noches desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the nights from the door.

meanings.note: Feminine all-female plural: nosotras.

examples.text: Nosotros abrimos la posada a las siete.
examples.trans: We open the guesthouse at seven.

examples.text: Siéntese a tomar té con nosotros.
examples.trans: Sit down and have tea with us.

meanings.note: Plural los papeles.

examples.text: El papel está aquí.
examples.trans: The paper is here.

examples.text: Vemos los papeles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the papers from the door.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Augmentative of puerta; drops the written accent in plural portones.

examples.text: Colgamos el cartel de madera junto al portón principal.
examples.trans: We hung the wooden sign beside the main front gate.

examples.text: El portón de la calle se cierra a las diez.
examples.trans: The street gate closes at ten o'clock.

meanings.note: Short for tarjeta postal.

examples.text: La postal está aquí.
examples.trans: The postcard is here.

examples.text: Vemos las postales desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the postcards from the door.

meanings.note: El próximo invierno = next winter.

examples.text: Es una pieza próxima.
examples.trans: It is a next piece.

examples.text: ¡Compra las dos! Una válvula de repuesto salva también el próximo invierno.
examples.trans: Buy both! A spare valve saves next winter too.

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

meanings.note: Sin querer = by accident; querer decir = to mean.

examples.text: ¿Quiere usted café o té caliente?
examples.trans: Would you like coffee or hot tea?

examples.text: Lo abrí sin querer.
examples.trans: I opened it by accident.

meanings.note: En recepción = at the front desk.

examples.text: La recepción está aquí.
examples.trans: The front desk is here.

examples.text: Vemos las recepciones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the front desks from the door.

meanings.note: Tener una reserva = to have a booking.

examples.text: La reserva está aquí.
examples.trans: The reservation is here.

examples.text: Vemos las reservas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the reservations from the door.

meanings.note: Irregular past participle of romper.

examples.text: Es una pieza rota.
examples.trans: It is a broken piece.

examples.text: Esta casa sobrevivió a ochenta inviernos y ayer a una válvula rota de la caldera.
examples.trans: This house survived eighty winters and one broken boiler valve yesterday.

meanings.note: Fin de semana = weekend; la semana que viene = next week.

examples.text: La semana está aquí.
examples.trans: The week is here.

examples.text: Vemos las semanas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the weeks from the door.

ser.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

meanings.en: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)
meanings.note: Used for names, professions, ownership (es mía), materials (es de madera), and clock time.

examples.text: Soy arquitecta y vivo en Valencia.
examples.trans: I am an architect and live in Valencia.

examples.text: Esa maleta azul es mía.
examples.trans: That blue suitcase is mine.

meanings.note: Polite form of address: señora Carmen.

examples.text: La señora está aquí.
examples.trans: The madam is here.

examples.text: Vemos las señoras desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the madams from the door.

meanings.note: Unaccented conjunction, distinct from accented sí ('yes').

examples.text: Avísame si necesitas otra manta.
examples.trans: Let me know if you need another blanket.

examples.text: Mira si queda leche en la nevera.
examples.trans: Check whether any milk is left in the fridge.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: suena).

examples.text: El despertador suena a las seis y media.
examples.trans: The alarm clock rings at six thirty.

examples.text: El piano sonaba cálido bajo la lluvia.
examples.trans: The piano sounded warm in the rain.

meanings.note: Conjugates like reír (sonrío, sonrió); imperative plural: ¡sonreíd!.

examples.text: La panadera siempre sonríe al abrir el horno.
examples.trans: The baker always smiles when opening the oven.

examples.text: Al probar el bizcocho, sonrió enseguida.
examples.trans: Upon tasting the cake, he smiled right away.

su.gloss: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)

meanings.en: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)
meanings.note: Plural sus (su maleta / sus maletas).

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave, señora.
examples.trans: Here is your key, madam.

examples.text: Sus habitaciones están en la primera planta.
examples.trans: Your rooms are on the first floor.

meanings.note: Forms: suyo, suya, suyos, suyas.

examples.text: El patio es todo suyo.
examples.trans: The courtyard is all yours.

examples.text: Tranquila, no es culpa suya.
examples.trans: Do not worry, it is not your fault.

meanings.note: Por la tarde = in the afternoon; ¡Buenas tardes! = Good afternoon!; llegar tarde = arrive late.

examples.text: ¡Buenas tardes! ¿Tienen una habitación libre?
examples.trans: Good afternoon! Do you have a room free?

examples.text: Perdón por llegar un poco tarde.
examples.trans: Sorry for arriving a little late.

meanings.note: Una taza de té = a cup of tea.

examples.text: La taza está aquí.
examples.trans: The cup is here.

examples.text: Vemos las tazas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the cups from the door.

meanings.note: ¿Qué tiempo hace? asks about the weather; a tiempo = on time.

examples.text: El tiempo está aquí.
examples.trans: The time is here.

examples.text: Vemos los tiempos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the times from the door.

meanings.note: Tocar el timbre = ring the bell.

examples.text: El timbre está aquí.
examples.trans: The bell is here.

examples.text: Vemos los timbres desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the bells from the door.

tocar.gloss: to touch; to ring (a bell); to play (an instrument)

meanings.en: to touch; to ring (a bell); to play (an instrument)
meanings.note: Preterite 1st sg spells c -> qu: toqué.

examples.text: Alguien acaba de tocar el timbre.
examples.trans: Someone just rang the bell.

examples.text: De niño tocaba el piano los viernes.
examples.trans: As a boy he played the piano on Fridays.

meanings.note: Todo el día = the whole day; todo el mundo = everyone; sobre todo = mostly.

examples.text: Todo está limpio y en su sitio.
examples.trans: Everything is clean and in its place.

examples.text: Camina todo recto por esta calle.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead down this street.

meanings.note: ¡Toma! = Here you go!; tomar un café = have a coffee.

examples.text: ¿Qué quiere tomar para desayunar?
examples.trans: What would you like to have for breakfast?

examples.text: Toma, aquí tienes la linterna.
examples.trans: Here you go, here is the flashlight.

meanings.note: Accented té ('tea') distinguishes the noun from pronoun te ('you').

examples.text: El té está aquí.
examples.trans: The tea is here.

examples.text: Vemos los tés desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the teas from the door.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Feminine: la vecina.

examples.text: El vecino está aquí.
examples.trans: The neighbour is here.

examples.text: Vemos los vecinos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the neighbours from the door.

meanings.note: Written as a single word in Spanish (21–29 combine into one word).

examples.text: Dos docenas de sillas son veinticuatro sillas.
examples.trans: Two dozen chairs is twenty-four chairs.

examples.text: La recepción está tranquila las veinticuatro horas.
examples.trans: The front desk is peaceful twenty-four hours a day.

meanings.note: Irregular: veo, vi, visto.

examples.text: Desde aquí veo el puente de piedra.
examples.trans: From here I see the stone bridge.

examples.text: ¡Nos vemos luego en el patio!
examples.trans: See you later in the courtyard!

vez.gloss: time / occasion (dos veces = twice; en vez de = instead of)

meanings.en: time / occasion (dos veces = twice; en vez de = instead of)
meanings.note: Plural las veces; a veces = sometimes; otra vez = again.

examples.text: La vez está aquí.
examples.trans: The time / occasion is here.

examples.text: Vemos las veces desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the time / occasions from the door.

meanings.note: Invariable in plural: el viernes ('on Friday'), los viernes ('on Fridays').

examples.text: El viernes está aquí.
examples.trans: The Friday is here.

examples.text: Vemos los viernes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the Fridays from the door.

volver.gloss: to return; to come back; to do again (volver a + inf)

meanings.en: to return; to come back; to do again (volver a + inf)
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: vuelvo), past participle vuelto; volverse + adj = become.

examples.text: Vuelvo en cinco minutos.
examples.trans: I will be back in five minutes.

examples.text: Volvió a sonreír enseguida.
examples.trans: He smiled again right away.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.
